generation_prompt: The robot closes its right thumb and fingers around the orange juice carton and lifts it off the pink plate. It carries the carton over the pink bowl behind the milk carton, lowers it upright into the bowl, and opens its right hand, leaving the carton standing in the bowl. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: Orange juice carton stands upright in the rear pink bowl. Right hand is open immediately beside it after releasing its grasp; left hand remains open and clear. Pink source plate is empty.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole manipulating hand: wraps thumb and fingers around the orange juice carton, lifts, transports, lowers into the destination bowl, and opens to release.
arm_hand_roles.left: Open nonparticipating hand remains clear at the near-left table edge, with modest lowering during right-arm transport; does not grasp, support, or transfer the carton.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand manipulation; no hand-to-hand transfer or person interaction.

uncertainties: The exact instant when the carton base contacts the bowl bottom is occluded by the bowl rim and foreground milk carton; upright placement and hand opening are visible.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
